'''2003 Chandrila State Championship David Destefanis DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2003 Chandrila State Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by David "Lirkas 'DDM'" Destefanis (2003-06-09).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=29178 Chandrila State 1st place DARK (a.ka. Ferocious Domination)]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061110043209/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=29178&PHPSESSID=29818f8b6da266174ddd746571e9b090 Internet Archive]</ref>
